user.title: Connect to VisionMesh
user.description:
Enter the address of your VisionMesh server and a VisionMesh account to sign in with.

A Viewer account is enough to see cameras. Use an Operator account if you want Home Assistant to control recording, privacy mode or camera movement.

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only if your server uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: VisionMesh sign-in failed
reauth_confirm.description: VisionMesh no longer accepts the saved account. Enter the details again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach VisionMesh at that address. Check that the server is running and on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: That username or password was not accepted.
error.invalid_url: That does not look like a valid address. It usually looks like http://192.168.1.10:8088
error.unknown: Something went wrong while connecting to VisionMesh.

abort.already_configured: That VisionMesh server has already been added.

init.title: Choose cameras
init.description: {count} camera(s) are available. Choose which should appear in Home Assistant.
